name: Shell Space Renderer
definition: A renderer for membrane components (oriented perpendicular to proxy geometry) that performs ray traversal on a three-level AS tree (µLAS, mLAS, nLAS). It uses ray-prism intersection tests at µLAS.
summary: The Shell Space Renderer visualizes membrane proteins using a three-level acceleration tree to compute transformations on the fly, minimizing memory while rendering intricate hierarchical details.
